ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central field spanning both lobes. Continuous black pigmentation band following the trailing edge. Multiple discrete dark circular blobs (focal spots) distributed across the lower half of both lobes, with a larger dark cluster localized near the base of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 50 degrees and a depth occupying approximately 15% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged boundary with peaks and valleys (5-15 pixel amplitude) along the entire trailing edge; notable larger notches on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a concave curve from the median notch to the distal tips. Leading edges exhibit a convex sweep trajectory toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 14 localized, roughly circular dark pixel clusters (5-15 pixels diameter) distributed primarily across the lower-medial quadrants of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible thin, diagonal dark linear disruptions on the mid-left lobe and several shorter, unaligned vertical scratches on the far-right lobe near the distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular dark scarring cluster at the peduncle-fluke junction; distinct deep notch-like indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately mid-way to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique grouping of four small dark spots forming a horizontal linear pattern in the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe.
